question: Does the component 24CW1280T-I_OT have a maximum I2C frequency of 1MHz according to its datasheet?

response.reasoning: The 24CW1280T-I/OT is a Microchip EEPROM (128KBIT). According to the Microchip 24CW series datasheet (referenced in the netlist: http://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/24CW16X-24CW32X-24CW64X-24CW128X-Data-Sheet-20005772B.pdf), the 24CW1280T supports I2C Fast-mode Plus (FM+) with a maximum clock frequency of 1MHz. This is consistent with the known specifications of this part.
